company_research.recent_news: Munich Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, primary insurance and insurance-related risk solutions. The group consists of the reinsurance and ERGO business segments, as well as the capital investment company MEAG. We are globally active and operate in all lines of the insurance business.
company_research.culture_signals: We recognize Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging as a key priority with a culture that welcomes different thoughts and opinions. We dare to think big and are continuously innovating on behalf of our clients. Munich Re is committed to providing a work environment that is inclusive and free of employment barriers and discrimination.
company_research.additional_context: Munich Re is the world's leading reinsurance company with more than 40,000 employees in over 50 locations around the globe. It invests strategically in its world-class talent, offering employees a work experience that promotes professional development, innovation, and rewards high performance. The company operates under a hybrid working model. They are focused on climate change and its related risks and opportunities for the insurance industry, using a combination of risk assessment, insurance solutions, and asset management. Munich Re has increasingly embraced digitalization and innovation, using advanced analytics, machine learning, and automation to improve underwriting, claims assessment, and risk modeling. They also invest in insurance technology startups and digital platforms. Founded in 1880, the company has a long history of scientific and analytical approach to risk, emphasizing actuarial discipline, data collection, and careful assessment of probabilities.
